description.zh:
资源类型。

您可以从[支持资源组的云服务](~~94479~~)的**资源类型**列获取。
description.en:
The resource type.

You can obtain the resource type from the **Resource type** column in [Services that work with Resource Group](~~94479~~).

description.zh:
云服务ID。

您可以从[支持资源组的云服务](~~94479~~)的**云服务代码**列获取云服务ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud service.

You can obtain the service code from the **Service code** column in [Services that work with Resource Group](~~94479~~).
Specifies whether a specific resource type or cloud service supports resource group events.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-resource-group-capability --service ecs --resource-type instance --support-resource-group-event true --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListResourceGroupCapability --region cn-hangzhou --SupportResourceGroupEvent true --Service ecs --ResourceType instance
